thread:
Sasha (CS): Quick draft of a customer-facing prefill & stream playbook for the Acme pilot. Need quick sanity check before I push to the CS repo.

Sasha (CS): Key sections: prefill timing, client batching recipe, streaming fallback policy, renewal-risk signals, short post-demo survey. Short + copy-paste remediation steps.

Jonah (Solutions): Looks good. Add a tiny example for client batching windows: recommend 100ms or 10 concurrent messages, whichever hits first.

Priya (SRE): Ops constraints: warm pool target = 3 GPUs reserved 20m before demo. Prefill top N=8 prefixes, TTL=15m. If KV hit rate <60% during demo, flip to reduced batch size.

Marta (PM): For renewal signal mapping: propose simple badge logic: Active (>75 req/day), Engaged (10-75), AtRisk (<10) + sustained error >2% = immediate AE alert.

Leo (AE): Can we include the exact copy I can paste in the renewal note? e.g., "Tenant saw <10 requests/day and >2% errors last 24h; recommend outreach."

Sasha (CS): Yes I'll add that copy under "AE handoff" with checklist of evidence to attach (logs, P95, recent survey).

Jonah (Solutions): SDK prefill snippet for customers: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -d '{"tenant_id":"acme","prefixes":["invoice","help_center","order_status"],"ttl":900}'
```

Priya (SRE): Monitoring snippets I'll add: PromQL for kv cache hit rate and P95 tokens/sec, plus alert thresholds. Example: `sum(rate(kv_cache_hits[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_requests[5m])) < 0.6` triggers yellow.

Sasha (CS): Streaming fallback policy (short): if streaming latency >800ms or model queue >50, switch to non-streaming abridged response (max tokens=60) and notify AE.

Marta (PM): Add a tiny decision tree graphic (1-pager) for AEs: green/yellow/red actions. I can mock and attach.

Leo (AE): Also include a 3-question post-demo survey link we can copy into the follow-up email. Short questions + thumbs required.

Sasha (CS): Draft survey: 1) Did responses match expectations? Y/N 2) Any major latency issues? 1-5 3) Would you recommend? Y/N + comments link. I'll host via CS form and attach id.

go-live-bot: Reminder: Enablement session with Acme scheduled tomorrow 09:00.

Sasha (CS): Next steps: I'll update the runbook doc and drop link in #customer-success. Priya, Jonah please drop your snippets by EOD. Marta to provide AE one-pager. Leo will prep the AE outreach email template. Meeting tomorrow 08:45 for final dry run. Any blockers?

Priya (SRE): No blockers from infra. I'll add the PromQL and scaling notes.

Jonah (Solutions): I'll polish the SDK examples and include a Node example too.

Marta (PM): One-pager coming.

Leo (AE): I'll prep outreach. Thanks team :thumbsup:
